<style>
:root{--bg:#d9eefa;--ink:#0a2540;--c:#1a8fc9;--a:#0b6aa2;--b:#0b5fd0;--v:#6a4cff;--m:#4a6a88;color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:#1e3d5c;font:400 16.5px/1.75 'Sora',system-ui,sans-serif}
#bg{position:fixed;inset:-6%;z-index:0;background:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,") center/cover no-repeat #cfe9f7;will-change:transform}
#name{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 17svh);z-index:1;margin:0;text-align:center;pointer-events:none;user-select:none;font:700 clamp(58px,17vw,260px)/.9 'Chakra Petch',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.93);-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px rgba(26,143,201,.55);text-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(26,143,201,.6),0 8px 60px rgba(11,95,208,.5)}
#c{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;z-index:2}
main{position:relative;z-index:4}
.bar{position:fixed;z-index:6;top:0;left:0;right:0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 12px) clamp(14px,4vw,40px) 20px;font:500 13px 'Chakra Petch',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;background:linear-gradient(rgba(234,246,253,.94),rgba(234,246,253,0))}
.who{color:var(--ink)}
.who i{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;margin-right:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--c),0 0 22px var(--c);animation:pu 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pu{50%{opacity:.35}}
.bar nav{display:flex;gap:clamp(8px,2vw,22px)}
.bar a{color:var(--m);text-decoration:none;padding:4px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:color .2s,border-color .2s,text-shadow .2s}
.bar a.on,.bar a:hover,.bar a:focus-visible{color:var(--a);border-color:var(--c);text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(26,143,201,.55);outline:none}
.hero{min-height:100svh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;text-align:center;padding:0 18px 8svh;pointer-events:none}
.type{margin:0;min-height:1.8em;font:500 clamp(14px,2.1vw,19px) 'Fira Code',monospace;color:var(--b);text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,.95),0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.type i{font-style:normal;color:var(--m)}
.caret{display:inline-block;width:.6em;height:1.05em;margin-left:3px;vertical-align:-.15em;background:var(--c);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--c);animation:bl 1s steps(2) infinite}
@keyframes bl{50%{opacity:0}}
.badges{margin-top:16px}
.badges span{display:inline-block;margin:0 5px 8px;padding:6px 14px;font:600 12px 'Chakra Petch',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#0b5a94;border:1px solid rgba(26,143,201,.65);background:rgba(255,255,255,.72);box-shadow:inset 0 0 14px rgba(26,143,201,.16),0 0 18px rgba(26,143,201,.28)}
.g{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:6svh clamp(16px,4vw,40px) 14svh;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:18px}
.pn{position:relative;grid-column:1/-1;padding:clamp(20px,3vw,32px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.62);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border:1px solid rgba(26,143,201,.42);box-shadow:inset 0 0 40px rgba(255,255,255,.55),0 0 38px rgba(26,143,201,.24);opacity:0;transition:opacity .7s,box-shadow .3s}
.pn.in{opacity:1}
.pn:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 40px rgba(255,255,255,.6),0 0 52px rgba(26,143,201,.42)}
.pn::before,.pn::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:16px;height:16px;border:2px solid var(--c);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(26,143,201,.8))}
.pn::before{top:-1px;left:-1px;border-right:0;border-bottom:0}
.pn::after{bottom:-1px;right:-1px;border-left:0;border-top:0}
.s7{grid-column:span 7}.s5{grid-column:span 5}

.gc{padding:22px 24px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);border:1px solid rgba(26,143,201,.45);box-shadow:inset 0 0 24px rgba(255,255,255,.5),0 0 22px rgba(26,143,201,.16)}

.gm{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rows{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:10px 12px;align-items:center;flex:1 1 220px}
.rows svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--c)}
.rows span{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px}

.ring{position:relative;width:104px;height:104px;flex:none}
.ring .rg{width:100%;height:100%}
.ring .tk{fill:none;stroke:rgba(26,143,201,.22);stroke-width:6}
.ring .ar{fill:none;stroke:var(--c);stroke-width:6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:34 243;transform-origin:50% 50%;animation:sp 6s linear infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(26,143,201,.8))}
@keyframes sp{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.ring .gh{position:absolute;left:22px;top:22px;width:60px;height:60px;color:var(--ink)}
.bar2{display:flex;height:10px;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(26,143,201,.15);margin-bottom:18px}
.seg{width:0;height:100%;background:var(--k);transition:width 1.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),opacity .2s}
.pn.in .seg{width:var(--w)}
.bar2.hl .seg{opacity:.3}.bar2.hl .seg.on{opacity:1}
.lg{display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-template-rows:repeat(3,auto);grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px 16px;font-size:13.5px}
.lg div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--ink);cursor:default;transition:opacity .2s}
.lg i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--k);flex:none}
.lg.hl div{opacity:.4}.lg.hl div.on{opacity:1}
@media(max-width:860px){.gs{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:560px){.lg{grid-auto-flow:row;grid-template-rows:none;grid-template-columns:1fr}}

.end{margin-top:26px;font:700 22px 'Chakra Petch',sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--b),var(--v));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.hint{position:fixed;z-index:6;right:clamp(14px,4vw,40px);bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 12px);font:400 12px 'Fira Code',monospace;color:var(--m);pointer-events:none}
@media(max-width:860px){.s7,.s5{grid-column:1/-1}.st{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.hint{display:none}}
@media(max-width:560px){.who span{display:none}.st,.lk,.tr{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.caret,.who i{animation:none}.pn{transition:none}}
</style></head>

 for(var j=0;j<GH;j++)for(var i=0;i<GW;i++){
  var k=(j*GW+i)*4;if(d[k+3]<140||Math.random()>.97)continue;
  var l=(.299*d[k]+.587*d[k+1]+.114*d[k+2])/255,t=Math.pow(Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(l-.05)/.85)),.8);
  var col=[.03+.12*t,.09+.42*t,.22+.5*t];
  col=mx3(col,[.2,.16,.6],(j/GH)*.25);var br=1;
  P.push((i/GW-.5)*PW,(.5-j/GH)*PH,(l-.5)*.5);
  C.push(col[0]*br,col[1]*br,col[2]*br);S.push(cell*1.5);D.push(Math.random());N.push(i/GW);
 }
 var g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
 g.setAttribute("position",new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(P,3));
 g.setAttribute("aCol",new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(C,3));
 g.setAttribute("aSize",new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(S,1));
 g.setAttribute("aSeed",new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(D,1));
 g.setAttribute("aColN",new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(N,1));
 U.atlas.value=makeAtlas();
 root.add(new THREE.Points(g,mat));
 t0=performance.now();
}
var t0=-1,wide=true,vw=1,vh=1;
var imgP=new Promise(function(res){var im=new Image();im.onload=function(){res(im);};im.src=IMG;});
var fontP=Promise.race([(document.fonts&&document.fonts.load?document.fonts.load("600 46px 'Fira Code'"):Promise.resolve()).catch(function(){}),new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,1500);})]);
Promise.all([imgP,fontP]).then(function(a){build(a[0]);});

function size(){
 var W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight,asp=W/H;wide=asp>1.15;
 R.setSize(W,H);cam.aspect=asp;cam.position.z=wide?8.5:10.5;cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
 vh=2*Math.tan(22.5*Math.PI/180)*cam.position.z;vw=vh*asp;
 root.scale.setScalar(wide?1:.8);root.position.x=0;root.position.y=vh*(wide?.04:.1);
 U.scale.value=R.domElement.height/(2*Math.tan(22.5*Math.PI/180));
}
addEventListener("resize",size);size();

/* ---------- pointer, scroll, replay ---------- */
var mx=0,my=0,tmz=0,mz=0,ry=0,rxr=0;
function pm(e){mx=e.clientX/innerWidth*2-1;my=-(e.clientY/innerHeight*2-1);tmz=1;}
addEventListener("pointermove",pm);addEventListener("pointerdown",pm);
addEventListener("pointerup",function(e){if(e.pointerType!=="mouse")tmz=0;});
document.documentElement.addEventListener("mouseleave",function(){tmz=0;});
function replay(){if(reduce)return;U.asm.value=0;t0=performance.now();}
addEventListener("click",function(e){if(e.target.closest&&e.target.closest("a"))return;if(scrollY<innerHeight*.8)replay();});
addEventListener("keydown",function(e){if(e.key==="r"||e.key==="R")replay();});

var clk=new THREE.Clock();
(function loop(){
 var t=clk.getElapsedTime();U.time.value=reduce?0:t;
 if(t0>0&&!reduce){var p=Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/3600);U.asm.value=1-Math.pow(1-p,3);}
 mz+=(tmz-mz)*.1;
 var sy=scrollY,sp=Math.min(1,sy/innerHeight);
 if(!reduce){bx+=((-mx*16)-bx)*.05;by+=((my*10-sy*.05)-by)*.05;bgEl.style.transform="translate3d("+bx.toFixed(2)+"px,"+by.toFixed(2)+"px,0) scale(1.06)";}
 var dm=Math.max(.08,1-sp*1.15);U.dim.value=dm;
 ry+=((mx*.3+sp*.55)-ry)*.06;rxr+=((-my*.1)-rxr)*.06;
 root.rotation.y=ry;root.rotation.x=rxr;
 U.mouse.value.set((mx*vw/2-root.position.x)/root.scale.x,(my*vh/2-root.position.y)/root.scale.x,mz);
 R.render(scene,cam);requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();

/* ---------- typing, reveal, nav, scramble ---------- */
var lines=["Building creative & experimental projects","Solving problems that make me think","Leading teams. Growing ideas.","Always curious to learn something new"];
var te=$("#typed"),li=0,ci=0,del=false;
function tick(){var s=lines[li];
 if(!del){ci++;te.textContent=s.slice(0,ci);if(ci===s.length){del=true;return setTimeout(tick,1800);}return setTimeout(tick,55);}
 ci--;te.textContent=s.slice(0,ci);if(ci===0){del=false;li=(li+1)%lines.length;return setTimeout(tick,350);}
 return setTimeout(tick,26);}
if(reduce)te.textContent=lines[0];else tick();

function typeInto(el,text,ms){
 if(reduce){el.textContent=text;return;}
 var n=0;(function s(){n++;el.textContent=text.slice(0,n);if(n<text.length)setTimeout(s,ms);})();}
var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){
 if(!e.isIntersecting||e.target.classList.contains("in"))return;
 e.target.classList.add("in");
 var c=$("[data-cmd]",e.target);if(c)typeInto(c,c.getAttribute("data-cmd"),60);
 $$(".cu",e.target).forEach(countUp);
 var q=$("[data-quote]",e.target);if(q)setTimeout(function(){typeInto(q,q.getAttribute("data-quote"),28);},400);
});},{threshold:.2});
$$(".pn").forEach(function(s){io.observe(s);});

function countUp(el){var v=parseFloat(el.getAttribute("data-v")),d=+el.getAttribute("data-d")||0;
 if(reduce||v===0){el.textContent=v.toFixed(d);return;}
 var s=performance.now();(function f(n){var p=Math.min(1,(n-s)/900);p=1-Math.pow(1-p,3);el.textContent=(v*p).toFixed(d);if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(f);})(s);}
var bar2=$(".bar2"),lg=$(".lg");
$$("[data-i]").forEach(function(n){
 n.addEventListener("mouseenter",function(){var i=n.getAttribute("data-i");bar2.classList.add("hl");lg.classList.add("hl");
  $$("[data-i]").forEach(function(m){m.classList.toggle("on",m.getAttribute("data-i")===i);});});
 n.addEventListener("mouseleave",function(){bar2.classList.remove("hl");lg.classList.remove("hl");});});
var links=$$(".bar a");
var io2=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){
 if(!e.isIntersecting)return;
 links.forEach(function(a){a.classList.toggle("on",a.getAttribute("data-s")===e.target.id);});
});},{rootMargin:"-40% 0px -50% 0px"});
$$("#hero,#about,#stack,#github,#connect").forEach(function(s){io2.observe(s);});

function scramble(el){
 var o=el.getAttribute("data-t")||el.textContent;el.setAttribute("data-t",o);var n=0;clearInterval(el._i);
 el._i=setInterval(function(){n++;var out="";
  for(var k=0;k<o.length;k++)out+=(o.charAt(k)===" "||k<n/2)?o.charAt(k):rg();
  el.textContent=out;if(n>=o.length*2){clearInterval(el._i);el.textContent=o;}},26);}
if(!reduce)$$(".sc,.sc0").forEach(function(s){s.addEventListener("mouseenter",function(){scramble(s);});});
})();
</script>
</body></html>
